name: Fern Meridian
tagline: The home cultivation cabinet that turns any corner into a living harvest.
positioning: Fern Meridian engineers climate-sealed growing towers for people who refuse to accept that fresh food is a supply-chain problem.

hero.h1: Grow like the future depends on it. Because it does.
hero.sub: Fern Meridian is a sealed vertical growing tower for the home — precision climate, spectral lighting, and a harvest calendar that never stops turning. One appliance, an endless season.

features.title: Cathedral-grade spectral light
features.description: Twelve tunable LED bands recreate the exact photonic signature of a mountain dawn, so basil, arugula, and strawberries ripen with flavor no greenhouse can match.

features.title: Sealed climate cell
features.description: The tower holds temperature, humidity, and CO2 within a fraction of a degree — no pests, no seasons, no excuses, no compromise on what your family eats.

features.title: Autonomous nutrient loop
features.description: Fifteen liters of recirculating water feed forty plant sites while the dosing engine mixes minerals on schedule. You refill once a month, and only then.

features.title: Harvest orchestration
features.description: The Meridian app stages your plantings so something is always ready to cut. Salad on Tuesday, herbs on Friday — choreographed like a great orchestra.

features.title: Living dashboard
features.description: Track root health, growth velocity, and yield-per-watt from your phone. Every leaf becomes a data point in your own quiet agricultural revolution.

features.title: Whisper-silent operation
features.description: Magnetic-levitation fans and a vibration-damped pump keep the tower under 28 decibels, quiet enough to live in a bedroom and beautiful enough to want to.

testimonials.quote: I stopped buying leafy greens eleven months ago. My Fern Meridian tower produces more butterhead than a family of four can eat, and it tastes like something grown on purpose.
testimonials.name: Dana Okoro

testimonials.quote: We deployed six units across our tasting rooms. Guests watch their garnish being harvested minutes before the plate. It reframed our entire farm-to-table story.
testimonials.name: Mathias Berger

testimonials.quote: As someone who kills every houseplant, I was skeptical. The tower does the thinking. My first cilantro harvest arrived on the exact day the app promised.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: A single 24-site tower for the ambitious apartment grower.
The definitive home tower with autonomous dosing and full climate control.
For chefs, lodges, and households running their own indoor farm.

homepage.footerBlurb: Fern Meridian builds sealed vertical growing towers for people who believe fresh food should begin at home, not at a distribution center.
